svg.title: Breakwater: rapid invasion and reaction-force gameplay
svg.desc: An original gameplay concept diagram showing preparation, arrival, deployment, contested ground capture, finite sustainment and handover or survivor recovery. Infantry, aerial and ground drones, onboard artillery, AWACS and rearm/refuel contribute together. Proposed force and stock allocations remain unvalidated.
svg.text: BOSCALI SUMMER / MEGAPLANE / GAMEPLAY ROLE / 17 NOV 2026
BREAKWATER: THE INVASION HUB
Bring a force. Establish a foothold. Keep it fighting. Recover the survivors.
01 / PREPARE
Embark a finite mixed expedition.
Personnel, craft, compatible stores and supplies
All support roles remain part of the package.
02 / ARRIVE AND OBSERVE
Escorts open a useful working area.
Actual AWACS tracks and a small aerial element
A large aircraft still needs room and protection.
03 / DEPLOY
Deliver the ground force and service kit.
Shuttles / supported drops / ground drones
The manifest actually moves to the ground.
04 / CAPTURE AND HOLD
Ground elements contest the objective.
Onboard artillery and drones support the fight.
Passing overhead grants no capture effect.
05 / SUSTAIN AND REINFORCE
Turn finite stores into useful sorties.
Rearm / refuel / recover damaged craft
Deliver stocks to real ground service equipment.
06 / HAND OVER OR RECOVER
Leave a sustainable foothold behind.
A base or supply route takes over; survivors return.
Replenish physically before the next expedition.
The carrier makes an invasion sustainable before a permanent base can.
Infantry + both drone domains + onboard artillery + AWACS + rearm/refuel operate as one combined role.
FIRST MANIFEST STUDY / WITHIN THE EXISTING 300 t
128 infantry
16 squad records / native positions
12 aerial drones
4 independently active at once
8 ground drones
Recon / fire / logistics roles
2 shuttles
Insertion, delivery and pickup
Counts and masses are design hypotheses, not measured assets.
STOCKS, SURVIVORS AND MEANINGFUL CONSEQUENCES
70 t transferable fuel + typed ammunition and supplies
Carrier contingency fuel remains a separate protected reserve.
Deployed survivors persist if the carrier retreats or is lost.
Recovery returns actual damage, people and remaining stores.
Handovers cannot bypass the faction expedition entity budget.
Reactor output does not manufacture fuel, ammunition or troops.
RESEARCH / GAMEPLAY SPECIFICATION ONLY / No carrier gameplay implementation, independent soldier AI or service acceptance established.
